en: Pretest your survey with simulated participants.
zh: 使用模拟参与者预试问卷。

en: No runs yet. Choose personas and questions to start a pretest.
zh: 暂无运行记录。选择人设与题目后即可开始预试。

en: Open the AI Assistant sidebar — models and MCP stay in Settings
zh: 打开 AI 助手侧栏 — 模型与 MCP 仍在设置中管理
通过对话设计当前项目

en: Select a project first to send messages.
zh: 请先选择一个项目再发送消息。

en: Select a project to start chatting.
zh: 请先选择项目再开始对话。

en: Not connected — open Settings to add an API key.
zh: 未连接 — 打开设置添加 API 密钥。

en: Select a configured model before sending. The previous provider may have been removed.
zh: 发送前请选择已配置的模型。之前的提供商可能已被移除。

en: Ask the Assistant to design this survey
zh: 让助手帮你设计这份问卷

en: AI Assistant is ready. Describe the survey or a change you want.
zh: AI 助手已就绪。描述你想要的问卷或修改即可。

en: Open Settings to connect an API key, or use Codex / MCP from Integrations.
zh: 打开设置连接 API 密钥，或通过集成使用 Codex / MCP。

en: Type a message… (e.g. 'Create a thermal comfort survey')
zh: 输入消息…（例如「创建一份热舒适问卷」）

en: Select a project and configure a model first.
zh: 请先选择项目并配置模型。
撤销上一次 AI 修改
预估：{calls} 次模型调用，{minTokens}–{maxTokens} tokens

en: Optional: what should the reviewers focus on? Press Send to start the review.
zh: 可选：希望评审重点关注什么？直接点发送即可开始评审。

en: Draft changed during the review; not applied
zh: 评审期间草稿已变更，未应用

en: Show Review mode in the Assistant composer
zh: 在助手输入框中显示「评审」模式

en: These are your defaults. The Review options in the composer can still change them for a single run.
zh: 这些是你的默认设置。助手输入框中的评审选项仍可在单次运行时修改。

en: Could not save to your account. Your choice applies in this browser only.
zh: 未能保存到账号，仅在当前浏览器生效。

en: Add an instruction to the running Agent…
zh: 给正在运行的智能体补充指令…
正在压缩上下文并继续…
正在核对刚保存的草稿…

en: Advanced path for Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT via MCP.
zh: 面向 Cursor、Claude 和 ChatGPT 的高级 MCP 路径。

en: Connect an OpenAI or OpenRouter API key for this browser.
zh: 为当前浏览器连接 OpenAI 或 OpenRouter API 密钥。

en: Optional details that help the Assistant stay aligned with this project.
zh: 这些信息是可选的，用于让助手在当前项目中保持方向一致。

en: Keep conversation context and learned preferences within this project.
zh: 仅在当前项目内保留对话背景和偏好。

en: Conversation continuity is handled automatically by the hosted Agent session for this project.
zh: 当前项目的对话连续性由托管 Agent 会话自动处理。

en: Experimental and maintenance controls. Most studies do not need these.
zh: 实验性与维护功能。大多数研究无需调整。

en: Review mode runs a panel of reviewer roles on the current survey, in rounds, and proposes revisions. Set your defaults here.
zh: 「评审」模式让多个评审角色分轮评审当前问卷并提出修订。可在此设置默认值。

en: Review generated surveys with multiple specialist prompts
zh: 使用多个专家提示审查生成的问卷

en: Download this conversation or clear it from the current project.
zh: 下载当前对话，或从当前项目中清空它。

en: Clear conversation history for this project?
zh: 清空此项目的对话历史？

en: Create a new project or select an existing one from the sidebar to get started.
zh: 请在侧栏新建项目，或选择已有项目开始。

en: Save failed — click Save to retry
zh: 保存失败 — 点击保存重试

en: Start a survey and track your progress.
zh: 开始创建问卷，查看项目进度。

en: Shows the project checklist and top-bar tour again.
zh: 重新显示项目清单和顶栏导览。

en: The fastest path is to start from a published template and adapt it.
zh: 最快的方式：从已发布的模板开始，再按需修改。

en: Ticks itself from this project. Preview and sharing are remembered on this browser.
zh: 根据本项目自动勾选。预览和分享记录保存在当前浏览器。

en: All set: the survey is live and responses are coming in.
zh: 全部就绪：问卷已上线，答卷正在进来。

en: Holds the images, video and audio your questions show. Text-only surveys can skip it.
zh: 存放题目要展示的图片、视频和音频。纯文字问卷可跳过。

en: Upload files or folders, import a Hugging Face dataset, or import a template’s media. Tag folders as set or category so questions can draw from them.
zh: 上传文件或文件夹、导入 Hugging Face 数据集，或从模板导入媒体。为文件夹标记 set 或 category，题目即可按文件夹抽取。

en: No media yet. Upload files, import from Hugging Face, or import a template’s media.
zh: 还没有媒体。可上传文件、从 Hugging Face 导入，或从模板导入。

en: Defines what participants see: pages, questions, media rules and trial order.
zh: 决定参与者看到什么：页面、题目、媒体规则和试次顺序。

en: Add questions (rating, choice, pairwise comparison, ranking, annotation, video and more) or Skills. Preview each question while you edit; changes auto-save to the draft.
zh: 添加题目（评分、选择、成对比较、排序、标注、视频等）或 Skill。编辑时可逐题预览，修改会自动保存到草稿。

en: No questions yet. Add one in Builder or ask the AI Assistant to draft the survey.
zh: 还没有题目。可在「设计」中添加，或让 AI 助手起草问卷。

en: Catches unclear wording, broken media and wrong randomisation before real participants see them.
zh: 在真实参与者之前发现表述不清、媒体失效或随机化错误。

en: Preview in the top bar opens an exact replica of the live survey. Practice lets you answer question by question and inspect the recorded data.
zh: 顶栏「预览」打开与线上问卷一致的副本；「试填」可逐题作答并查看记录下来的数据。

en: Not tried yet. Take the full preview once before releasing.
zh: 尚未试填。发布前请完整预览一遍。

en: AI-simulated respondents give a quick pretest and hypothesis sketch. They never mix into human results.
zh: AI 模拟受访者，用于快速预试和假设探索，绝不会混入真人结果。

en: Choose a model and sample size, start a run, then review the answers. Runs continue in the background.
zh: 选择模型和样本量，开始运行，再查看作答。运行会在后台继续。

en: Silicon samples are turned off. Turn them on in Assistant settings to use this step.
zh: 硅基样本已关闭。可在 AI 助手设置中开启后使用此步骤。

en: Turns your draft into the participant version. The platform hosts the survey link, so there is nothing to deploy.
zh: 把草稿变成参与者版本。问卷链接由平台托管，无需另行部署。

en: Fix anything the pre-launch check flags, release a version (later releases update the same link), then copy the link or download the QR code.
zh: 先处理发布前检查提示的问题，再发布版本（之后的发布沿用同一链接），然后复制链接或下载二维码。

en: Not released yet. Releasing makes the current draft the participant version.
zh: 尚未发布。发布后，当前草稿即成为参与者版本。

en: Turns responses into per-question summaries you can export and report.
zh: 把答卷整理成可导出、可汇报的逐题结果。

en: Filter responses, read per-question charts, see TrueSkill rankings for comparisons with one tab per category, export CSV/JSON, or ask the AI Assistant to explain a result.
zh: 筛选答卷、查看逐题图表；成对比较题按类别分标签显示 TrueSkill 排名；可导出 CSV/JSON，或让 AI 助手解释结果。

en: No responses yet. Share the link, then come back here.
zh: 还没有答卷。先分享链接，再回到这里。

en: AI Assistant: help on every step
zh: AI 助手：每一步都能帮忙

en: Click AI in the top bar to chat about the current project. Choose a mode in the message box:
zh: 点击顶栏「AI」，就当前项目对话。在输入框选择模式：

en: Plans and carries out multi-step work: reads the draft, edits it, imports media, and asks before risky actions.
zh: 规划并完成多步任务：读取草稿、修改、导入媒体，执行高风险操作前会先征求同意。

en: Drafts a complete survey from your description in one go.
zh: 根据你的描述一次性起草完整问卷。

en: Makes only the change you ask for and keeps everything else as it is.
zh: 只做你要求的修改，其余内容保持不变。

en: Read-only. Answers questions about the survey or its results without changing anything.
zh: 只读。回答关于问卷或结果的问题，不做任何修改。

en: Multiple reviewer roles rate and comment on the survey in rounds, then propose revisions you can apply.
zh: 多个评审角色分轮为问卷打分和点评，并提出可应用的修订。

en: The Assistant uses your own API key (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI and others), saved in AI & Integrations.
zh: AI 助手使用你自己的 API 密钥（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等），保存在「AI 与集成」中。

en: The AI Assistant is turned off. Turn it on in Assistant settings.
zh: AI 助手已关闭，可在 AI 助手设置中开启。

en: Advanced: Codex, Cursor or Claude Code via MCP
zh: 进阶：通过 MCP 使用 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code

en: Connect an external agent in AI & Integrations. It edits the same draft with the same safety checks. Example prompt:
zh: 在「AI 与集成」中连接外部智能体，它会以相同的安全检查编辑同一份草稿。示例提示词：

en:
Using sp_survey MCP, create a survey about <your topic>.
Add question types <question types>.
My media is <description> at <folder location>.
zh:
使用 sp_survey MCP，创建一份关于 <你的主题> 的问卷。
加入题型 <题型说明>。
我的媒体是 <描述>，位于 <文件夹位置>。

en: Open your projects, create a new one, or start from a published template.
zh: 打开你的项目、新建项目，或从已发布的模板开始。

en: Work left to right: Dataset, Builder, Share, Results. Practice and Silicon help you test.
zh: 从左到右：媒体、设计、分享、结果。「试填」和「硅基」用于测试。

en: Edits save to your draft automatically. The participant link changes only when you release.
zh: 修改会自动保存到草稿。只有发布后，参与者链接的内容才会变化。

en: Answer the whole survey exactly as participants will.
zh: 以参与者视角完整作答整份问卷。

en: Ask the Assistant to build or change the survey from any tab.
zh: 在任意标签页让助手构建或修改问卷。

en: Opens the participant link in a new tab.
zh: 在新标签页打开参与者链接。

en: Theme, Skills library, and your account.
This Introduction tab keeps the checklist, and Restart guide brings everything back.
zh: 「简介」标签页保留清单，「重新开始引导」可恢复全部提示。
导入模板 / 预览媒体

en: Copy media from a published template or the admin preview media library. Existing files are skipped so imports can resume.
zh: 从已发布模板或管理端预览媒体库复制文件。已存在文件会跳过，便于断点续传。

en: Upload into the current folder in Media library
zh: 上传到媒体库中的当前文件夹

en: Each file: max {mb} MB. Image compression is optional; video, audio and animated GIFs retain their original data.
zh: 单文件上限 {mb} MB。图片可选择压缩；视频、音频和动态 GIF 保留原文件。

en: "{name}" is too large ({size} MB). Video/audio max is {mb} MB.
zh: 「{name}」过大（{size} MB）。视频/音频上限 {mb} MB。

en: No folders tagged yet. In Media library, check folders on the left and click Set or Category. Tagged folders will appear here for survey assignment.
zh: 尚未标记文件夹。在媒体库左侧勾选文件夹，再点击“分组”或“分类”。标记后的文件夹会显示在这里，供问卷分配使用。

en: Folders tagged set. Each folder’s direct files stay together when a question uses “Random fixed sets” with a matching media count.
zh: 标记为分组的文件夹。题目使用“随机固定分组”且媒体数量匹配时，文件夹内直属文件会一起展示。

en: Folders tagged category. Questions can draw random files from each category.
zh: 标记为分类的文件夹。题目可从每个分类中随机抽取文件。
正在检查 R2 中的现有图片…

en: Batch-import from HuggingFace. Use owner/dataset (rows) or owner/dataset/folder (recursive; nested folders kept). Resume reuses the first import destination to avoid nested duplicates.
zh: 从 HuggingFace 批量导入。使用 owner/dataset（按行）或 owner/dataset/folder（递归；保留嵌套文件夹）。继续导入会复用首次目标路径，避免重复嵌套。

en: Tag folders as set. Each tagged folder’s direct files are shown together (set size must match the question’s media count).
zh: 将文件夹标记为分组（Set）。每个分组文件夹的直属文件会一起展示，每组文件数须与题目的媒体数量一致。

en:
1. Create folders block01, block02, block03
2. Put 2 images in each folder (same count)
3. Check those folders → click Set
4. In Survey Builder, choose media mode Random fixed sets with count = 2
→ each respondent sees one whole folder (both images together)
zh:
1. 创建文件夹 block01、block02、block03
2. 每个文件夹放 2 张图（数量相同）
3. 勾选这些文件夹 → 点击“分组”
4. 在问卷构建中选择媒体分配方式「随机抽取完整分组」，数量 = 2
→ 每位受访者看到一整文件夹（两张图一起）

en: Tag folders as category. In Survey Builder, choose Per category and set Files per category. Each tagged folder contributes that many random file(s) (drawn recursively).
zh: 将文件夹标记为分类（Category）。在题目中选择「按分类抽取」，并设置每个分类抽取的文件数。每个分类会从该文件夹及其子文件夹中随机抽取。

en:
1. Create folders street and park
2. Put several images in each (subfolders OK)
3. Check those folders → click Category
4. In the question: Media Assignment → Per category, Files per category = 2
→ each respondent sees 2 street + 2 park images (4 total)
zh:
1. 创建文件夹 street 与 park
2. 每个放若干图片（可用子文件夹）
3. 勾选这些文件夹 → 点击“分类”
4. 在题目中：媒体分配 → 按分类抽取，每类文件数 = 2
→ 每位受访者看到 2 张 street + 2 张 park（共 4 张）

en: Design questions and configure your survey.
The main title that appears at the top of your survey
zh: 显示在问卷顶部的主标题

en: A brief description explaining the purpose of your survey
Shown to participants after they submit the survey
zh: 参与者提交后显示的内容

en: Close the survey automatically after this many responses (leave empty for unlimited)
zh: 达到该答卷数后自动关闭问卷（留空表示不限）

en: Organize your survey into pages. Drag pages to reorder them.
zh: 将问卷组织为多个页面。可拖拽页面调整顺序。

en: Publish your survey and invite participants.
zh: 发布问卷，邀请参与者作答。

en: Scan to open this survey. Download a 1024 × 1024 PNG for sharing or printing.
zh: 扫码打开此问卷。可下载 1024 × 1024 PNG，用于分享或打印。

en: Could not generate the QR code.
Local preview only. Use the deployed site to share with participants.
zh: 当前为本地预览，请在线上平台分享问卷。

en: No project selected. Please select or create a project first.
zh: 未选择项目。请先选择或创建项目。

en: Send it via email, WeChat, Slack, or any other channel
zh: 可通过邮件、微信、Slack 等渠道发送

en: Download the QR code from Your Survey Link above for invitations, slides or printed materials
zh: 在上方“你的问卷链接”中下载二维码，可用于邀请、幻灯片或印刷材料
同一个研究使用同一个链接

en: With version management enabled, publish a release to update this link. Saving only updates your draft.
zh: 启用版本管理后，发布正式版本才会更新链接；保存只更新草稿。

en: Results go to Supabase in real time and can be viewed in the Results Analysis tab
zh: 结果实时写入 Supabase，可在结果分析标签页查看

en: Share this link with collaborators who need to edit the survey. They will need to sign in.
zh: 分享给需要编辑问卷的协作者；对方需登录。
当前分析和导出包含 {shown} / {total} 份提交。

en: CSV contains one row per submission. ZIP includes per-trial tables and summaries.
zh: CSV 每行一份提交；ZIP 包含逐轮长表和汇总。

en: Filters are saved in this browser; they do not modify the survey.
zh: 筛选偏好仅保存在当前浏览器，不会修改问卷。

en: No submissions match these filters. Reset filters to see all responses.
zh: 没有符合当前筛选条件的提交。重置筛选可查看全部答卷。

en: One answer evaluates the entire displayed media group. Each ordered group is counted once.
zh: 一次回答评价整组展示媒体，每种有序媒体组合只计一次。
已回答 {answered} / {total} 份提交（{rate}%）· {people} 位参与者

en: These responses span multiple questionnaire revisions. Analysis and export use the selected version only to avoid mixing incompatible settings. Switch versions below; historical responses without a revision remain unknown.
zh: 这些答卷涉及多个问卷版本。分析和导出仅使用当前所选版本，避免新旧设置混算。可在下方切换；未记录版本的历史答卷仍标为未知。

en: Analyze survey responses per question for project:
This analysis did not produce a complete report. Run the analysis again.
zh: 此次分析未生成完整报告，请重新运行分析。

en: Delete this saved analysis report? Survey responses will be kept.
zh: 删除这份已保存的分析报告？调查答卷将保留。

en: Could not save the analysis report. Please try again.
zh: 分析报告保存失败，请重试。

en: Could not delete the report. Please try again.
No analysis report yet. Analyze current results to generate one.
zh: 还没有分析报告。点击“分析当前结果”生成。

en: This report used a previous range. Analyze again to update.
zh: 这份报告来自之前的分析范围。请重新分析以更新。

en: New responses arrived after this report. Analyze again to update.
zh: 报告之后又有新答卷。请重新分析以更新。
标注 × 感知 深入分析

en: Dates use {tz}. Records without a valid timestamp are excluded when a date filter is active.
zh: 日期按 {tz} 计算。启用日期筛选时，没有有效时间戳的记录不纳入。

en: Quality flags are checks, not deletions.
zh: 质量标记只是检查信息，不会自动删除答卷。

en: Some historical responses have no frozen question contract. Current settings are a fallback.
zh: 部分历史答卷没有冻结题目合同，当前分析使用现有设置作为替代。

en: Formal analysis uses human responses unless you choose practice or a Silicon run.
zh: 正式分析默认使用真人数据；练习或 Silicon 需明确选择。
分析时排除已标记答卷
至少有 1 条作答的可答题

en: Remove individual submissions from this project. Deletion is permanent.
zh: 删除本项目的单条提交。删除后不可恢复。

en: View answers, trial details and quality flags for each submission.
zh: 查看每份提交的答案、逐轮详情及质量标记。

en: No responses collected yet. Share your survey link and come back here to view results.
zh: 尚无答卷。分享问卷链接后，再回到这里查看结果。

en: Custom skill results reuse native charts by declared type: annotation overlays (points/path/polygon/bbox), media ranking (number/boolean with imageUrl), or text/ranking/allocation charts.
zh: 自定义 Skill 结果按声明类型复用原生分析：标注类（points/path/polygon/bbox）叠加热力/图形；媒体评分类按图片排序；文字/排序/分配类用对应原生图表。

en: This skill stores multiple tasks in one question, distinguished by mode (e.g. cue ranking / route trace).
zh: 此 Skill 把多种任务写在同一个题里，用 mode 区分（例如线索排序 / 路线描绘）。
